notepad_final: Observations: select executes movement; repeated select moves 6 and visible internal 8 blocks right by one 3-cell step. Fresh left arms a one-step left move for 11 on the next select. Driving 8-right + armed 11-left to collision resets movers and converts one bottom palette 8-slot from 8 to 4; converting all three causes GAME_OVER at 0%, so stop before the third conversion. Up/down from reset and from the one-conversion state showed no clear movement. Right from the far-right start showed no clear effect; a later right+select adjacency probe suggests 11 does not track right with 8, so right is likely irrelevant too. Current state: exactly two bottom palette slots are now 4 (middle and right), leftmost remains 8. Plain-select probes from the two-conversion state have only caused routine 6/8 right drift with no palette change. Current plan: continue safe plain selects to march internal 8 right and watch for the first non-routine interaction (wall, fixed 11, or reset) before risking the third conversion. Repeated safe plain selects continue routine right drift with no visible palette or 11 change yet.

Observed so far: non-reset inputs (right/left/up/down/select) mostly act as generic timesteps, not direct movement. Fresh-state reset probes: immediate select and fresh right/up/left/down each showed no obvious visible difference; select immediately after them also showed no visible effect. The 6 block and inner 8 blocks oscillate horizontally by about 3 cells per active step, with occasional stall/pause-looking frames and periodic wrap/relocation from far right back left without full reset. Timed selects tested immediately after suspected wrap/reversal, in far-right/rightward phase, and on apparent far-right stall/endpoint frame all showed no obvious visible effect. Undo twice showed no obvious rewind. 2/3 structures and the small hollow 14 look fixed. The 11 cluster may have shifted once early, then mostly stable. The long bottom strip shrank from the right as 14, then changed to 11 while score/state stayed unchanged; post-expiry long 11 strip also keeps shrinking from the right with no visible consequence yet. Current strategy: keep advancing to seek a clearer event near 11, boundaries, hollow 14, or a new phase change; try select only if a distinctly different interaction frame appears. Latest observation: another timestep still shows the same periodic motion and no new visible interaction.

Level 1 observations: playfield uses 3x3 macro-cells. Hollow 3x3 ring of 14 near lower-left has not moved. Bottom long 14 bar is likely UI/move-time limit; running out ended the level. Strongest rule: left/right move the active lower-right 11 cluster one macro-cell horizontally; lane pieces 6 and moving 8 drift horizontally automatically each turn. Repeated left can reset/wrap moving pieces and can convert bottom legend/UI 8 groups into persistent 4 groups. Best pure-left run: 2/3 legend groups converted; leftmost stayed 8. Late-cycle tests of select/up/down/right showed no simple direct effect beyond timing/state changes. Key branch timing: state where leftmost legend group is still 8 while the other two are 4. Single early up there -> familiar 2/3 state. Single early down there -> familiar 2/3 state. Single early select there was the first clearly different branch: it could restore all three legend groups to 8 and later produce altered orders such as only rightmost converted or rightmost+middle converted, but after more lefts it still often collapsed back toward the familiar 2/3 state. Undo seems too shallow/local to revisit branch points reliably. Fresh-state select before any conversions produced no immediate visible change and later drifted toward familiar patterns. Strongest select evidence now: select pressed directly in the familiar 2/3 state can restore the bottom legend to all three 8 groups without a full reset, but a resumed left can drop it back toward familiar patterns. Clarification from late tests: some repeated-select states visibly leave leftmost and middle legend groups at 8 while only the rightmost is 4. Current endgame test: keep chaining select around these late states because select is the only action that has shown meaningful phase/rewind effects.
